findings.finding: VALIDATION.md identifies 26.10.0 and Artifact Contract v2; generated documentation gate did not cover it.
findings.remediation: Generate and gate VALIDATION.md from canonical 26.10.2 sources.

findings.finding: Gate A/C and schema/reference checks still use role-deliverables.v2.json as an authority.
findings.remediation: Use ArtifactContract v3 for all production validation; freeze v2 as read/migration fixture only.

findings.finding: 1124 v3 contracts omit migration provenance although the migration script emits it; the schema rejects that emitted field.
findings.remediation: Add schema-supported migration provenance to all 1124 contracts and verify source hashes.

findings.finding: ArtifactContract v2 retention is not represented in the 26.10.1 v3 lifecycle and the migration-loss test samples too few fields.
findings.remediation: Restore retention in lifecycle and compare every material v2 field across all 1124 contracts.

findings.finding: ProjectionManifest schema requires JAI lineage, but projection.py does not emit it.
findings.remediation: Emit and schema-validate L1-L6 lineage in every new ProjectionManifest.

findings.finding: ProductFragment schema requires object_ref/object_hash/contract_ref/context_digest, but fabric runtime does not persist these consistently.
findings.remediation: Attach deterministic canonical semantic identity and lineage to every fragment/evidence write.

findings.finding: Drive distribution exposes the 26.10.1 ZIP without matching TGZ/checksum sidecars.
findings.remediation: Produce ZIP, TGZ and SHA-256 manifest for 26.10.2; detached signing remains external owner action.

verification_result: all identified 26.10.1 carry-over findings remediated; release distribution sidecars are produced by release_bundle.py and external signature remains release-owner controlled
